name: How to be a Hero
source: The Goddess of Lewds, Lady Sluttony, has had her power stolen and divided among three wicked people. You are her last paladin and it is up to you to face them and take back your goddess's power. Travel the land, fight enemies, lewd monstergirls/boys.
translation: 淫欲女神Sluttony的力量遭人窃取，被三个恶人瓜分。你是她最后的圣骑士，必须面对他们，夺回女神的力量。游历各地，对抗敌人，与魔物娘和魔物男孩尽享情色之欢。
